# Ui Runtime Agent Context

> TD-first map for agents. Start from tech design and capability intent before implementation files.

- [Tech Design](tech-design): implementation source of truth.

## Capability Map

## Agent Workflow

- Capability next action: `aw capability next --project ui-runtime`.
- Readiness: `aw health --project ui-runtime`.
- Blockers: `aw health --project ui-runtime blockers`.

## Commands

- Test: `cargo test -p cclab-ui-runtime`.
